A dead stalker. The group's runner, a novice in the Zone. He was supposed to bring Dark a new artifact detector but didn't make it.
A Zaton stalker, a companion of Gloomy.
The leader of the group tasked with preparing the Customer's raid. He set up the stashes.
Documents Beard asked you to recover from a stash on Zaton. Owl may also be interested.
Beard asked you to recover documents from a stash on Zaton. Find the marked box and take the documents.
The documents are found. Take them to Beard at the Skadovsk: he promised 2000 rubles and equipment.
You can return the documents to Beard or look for another buyer. Talk to Pilot at the Skadovsk.
Pilot suggested that Owl might be interested. Owl will pay 5000 rubles, but Beard will be disappointed.
A small locked case left in a stash. Something heavy is clearly inside. Looks like it can't be opened without a specialist.
The second case mentioned in the note from the first stash. The first one clearly didn't disappoint, so this one should be useful too.
The third case mentioned in the note from the second stash. Need to open it and find out if there's anything else.

Damn it... I didn't expect things to turn out this way... The main thing is... (coughs up blood) Khh, khh... I hope... Dark can find it... At the farmstead... At the farmstead... damn it. And the detector... I didn't hand it over... I hope... khh... khh... he fills in all the stashes...
To the courier: the second case is on the bridge above.
To the courier: the third case is hidden at the Emerald. I hid it by the stage.
To the courier: tell your boss we're meeting as usual, at the gas station.
Filya's dying message mentioned some stashes. I think it's worth finding them all.
Filya's PDA mentions a farm. I think the first stash should be somewhere there.
Maybe the technician can open it.
The note mentions some bridge. It also says it's somewhere "above".
Maybe the technician can open it again.
The note mentions that the stash is hidden by the stage at the Emerald.
Take the third case to the mechanic.
Major wrote that we meet at the gas station. Time to find out what happened there.

[28.07.2012] Major: Hey, Dark. I've set up the first stash. You drop in the artifacts yourself, as we agreed. Just not like last time. Filya, where's the new detector? Don't forget.
 [28.07.2012] Filya: I'll bring it. I just need to pick it up from the station. I'll be there by evening.
 [28.07.2012] Dark: I won't go on a bender. The Customer pays well, everything will be on time. By the way, when does everything need to be ready?
 [28.07.2012] Major: He said to finish by the 30th. Does everyone have everything?
 [28.07.2012] Dark: Don't worry, it'll all be top-notch.
 [29.07.2012] Major: Well? I dropped by the first stash yesterday to leave the stuff, and I don't see the artifact. Fine, there's still a day, hope you make it, Dark. I've tossed a PDA with markers for the next stashes into each one. Write back when you read this.
 [29.07.2012] Major: Filya, did you give Dark the detector?
 [29.07.2012] Filya: Not yet. I'm looking for him. He's not answering.
 [29.07.2012] Major: So where is he? God damn it... This isn't like the previous times, the Customer is serious. Fuck, now we're definitely in trouble. Fine, I'll try to negotiate.
 [30.07.2012] Major: God damn it!!! Dark, where are you? The Customer is furious! Said he'd give us one more day, no more! Fuck, do I really have to go myself again? Answer, quick.
 [30.07.2012] Filya: Major... I'm at the forestry... we agreed to meet with Dark, but... something's wrong... I've got a bad feeling...
 [30.07.2012] Major: Filya, are you all right? Did Dark take off or something? Then why isn't he answering?
 [31.07.2012] Major: Filya? Dark? Where are you?
 [1.08.2012] Major: Well, you're your usual selves, of course... Fine, at least I managed to get everything and stash it. God damn it... Because of you the plans nearly went sideways again. Anyway, I've marked the gas station for the messengers. I wrote it in the third stash, in case you actually go through them. We meet tonight.
 [1.08.2012] Major: So where are you, damn it? And these messengers... They're nervous...
 [1.08.2012] Major: Fine. I'll hold the meeting alone. If you read this, come.
 [1.08.2012] Major: God d... d-don't come... It's a setup...
Beard, do you have a job involving documents?
There is one thing. A box with documents was hidden on Zaton. Find it and bring the papers to me. I'll pay two thousand and add some equipment. I'll send a mark to your PDA.
Deal. I'll bring the documents.
Beard, I found your documents.
Thanks, you saved me. Here are the promised two thousand, a pistol, ammo, and medical supplies.
Pilot, who might want these documents?
Show them to Owl. He loves rare papers and will probably pay more. But you'll have to explain yourself to Beard afterwards.
Understood. I'll think about who to give them to.
Owl, I hear you're interested in documents.
I am. Five thousand for these. Decide: are you selling or not?
Deal. The documents are yours.
No, I promised to return them to Beard.
Hold on, stalker. I know what papers you're carrying. Hand them over — you'll get two thousand and leave in peace.
All right. Take the documents, give me the money.
I won't give them up for two thousand. Add something.
You'll get nothing. Step aside!
Fine. Two thousand and a Sunrise suit. That's the final offer.
Deal. Money and armor for the documents.
No. The documents stay with me.
Not enough. Give more.
You think I'm a fool? Then we'll take them by force!
Hi, I found a case like this — can you open it?
Hi, it's me with a case again. Could you help once more?
Hi, I found a third case too. Could you help once more?
Let me have a look...
Give it here...
Sure, let's take a look...
(hands over the case)
So... I think I can open it for 2000.
Hmm, it's not much harder than the previous one. I can open it for 2000.
Whoa, what do we have here... You know, this case is a bit more interesting. But still, 2000 is a good price for it.
All right, deal. [-2000 RUB]
I'll think about it.
I don't have that kind of money right now.
